name: TANISHKA
summary: B.Tech Computer Science student specializing in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing with hands-on experience in building end-to-end text classification systems. Proficient in Python, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn with experience in deep learning models (LSTM, CNN-LSTM) and feature engineering techniques (TF-IDF, Word2Vec, FastText). Experienced in building and deploying ML models for real-world applications.

projects.title: Cyberbullying Detection Model
projects.description: Designed a multi-class text classification system for detecting harmful social media content. Implemented ML and DL models for benchmarking performance. Generated embeddings using Word2Vec, FastText, and GloVe with PCA. Performed sentiment analysis and feature engineering on large-scale Twitter datasets. Compared multiple models to identify the best-performing architecture.

projects.title: Speech Emotion Recognition System (ML & DL)
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end SER system using the RAVDESS dataset for multi-class emotion classification. Extracted audio features (MFCC, Chroma, Mel Spectrogram) using Librosa. Built and compared ML (SVM, Random Forest, LightGBM) and DL models (CNN, LSTM, CNN-BiLSTM). Achieved 90% accuracy using CNN-BiLSTM, capturing spatial and temporal patterns. Developed a web interface (HTML, CSS) with backend integration using Flask (app.py).

projects.title: Fake News Detection System
projects.description: Developed NLP pipeline using NLTK (tokenization, stemming, stopword removal). Applied feature extraction (TF-IDF, PCA, Truncated SVD). Built models: Logistic Regression, SVM, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, CNN-BiLSTM. Improved performance using hyperparameter tuning and class balancing. Evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score.
